name: Cribbage
description: Cribbage is a card game card game that involves gameplay, scoring, strategy. The game originated in England (early 17th century) and has become popular in the English-speaking world.

content.text: Cribbage is a card game card game that involves gameplay, scoring, strategy. The game originated in England (early 17th century) and has become popular in the English-speaking world.

Country/Region of Origin: England
Time Period: Early 17th century
Historical Development: Derived from the old English game of Noddy; attributed to Sir John Suckling. Rules published in England (Cotgrave 1662, Willughby 1672, Cotton 1674).
Cultural Significance: Britain's national card game; popular in English-speaking world, including USA, Canada, Australia.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
